messages:
riley: Heads-up: promotion for release/3.0.0 is blocked — image signing step failed in postsubmit.

ci-bot: Postsubmit publish job failed: build/image-sign (exit 1) https://ci.internal/runs/200123 :x:

riley: Error snippet: 'signing: failed to fetch signing-token: 401 Unauthorized'. Happening during gpg signing call.

ana?: wait, who is onsec today?

ana?: (typo) sorry, meant ana.

ana: I'm on it. Seen similar after our short-lived SA token rotation last night. Could be stale token cached on some runners.

patrick: Deploy-bot paused promotion: :warning:

deploy-bot: Promotion paused for release/3.0.0 by CI gate (image-sign failed). I will auto-unpause when image-sign stage passes on main + canary.

ana: Checking runner logs. Some runners have valid tokens, others return 401 from signing-service. The signing-service logs show 'token not found' for upload requests from runner-id: bk-87/90.

riley: Could we re-run just the signing job on the failing runners after clearing token cache?

patrick: Options: 1) invalidate runner token cache + rerun signing stage 2) fallback: sign on a different runner and reupload signed image 3) revert image change and promote later 4) request signing-service team to accept old tokens for a grace period (not ideal).

ana: I can push a small admin step: rotate cached tokens on the affected self-hosted runners and trigger the signing step. I have scripts: ```ssh runner-bk-87 'sudo systemctl restart runner-token-cache' && curl -X POST https://ci.internal/api/runs/200123/retry?stage=image-sign```

ci-bot: Manual retry endpoint: https://ci.internal/manual/200123?action=retry-stage&stage=image-sign

riley: Change window cutoff in 25m. If we can't get a reliable signed image before cutoff, we should defer.

patrick: Quick note: if we sign elsewhere we must ensure provenance metadata includes builder-run id to pass attestations. Avoid ad-hoc signing that loses traceability.

ana: Rotated caches on runners bk-86..bk-90 and retried signing at 1756007900. Waiting on results.

ci-bot: Retry result: image-sign succeeded on 2 of 5 runners, still failing on 3 with 401.

riley: Hm. Looks like some runners didn't pick up rotated token, might need a full agent restart. That takes ~5m per runner.

patrick: If we serial restart all 3, that may still fit the window — but it's noisy. Anyone object to doing that?

ana: I'll restart the runner agents now: ```for r in bk-88 bk-89 bk-90; do ssh $r 'sudo systemctl restart runner-agent'; done```

ci-bot: New retry started at 1756008050.

ci-bot: Retry result: image-sign stage passed on all runners at 1756008120.

deploy-bot: Promotion resumed for release/3.0.0. Canary image pushed to us-east-1.

patrick: Good catch. Action items: ana -> file infra-1259 to add token-rotation healthcheck and runner-agent restart as automated remediation; riley -> add release-note line about transient signing-service token rotation; infra -> add a grace-window on signing-service to accept tokens rotated within last 10m for CI jobs.

riley: Release note draft: "Temporary hold during image signing due to token rotation causing intermittent 401s on a subset of self-hosted runners. Automated remediation (runner agent restart) performed; INFRA-1259 filed to automate detection/remediation."

ana: I'll follow up with signing-service team to add short-lived grace acceptance or a pubsub to notify runners when rotation happens.

patrick: Closing provisional hold for now but leaving monitoring on sign/attest pipeline for 2h.

riley: Thanks everyone — reopening if any regressions.
